plan: Drive: from District of Hudsons Hope, about 73 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Canyon Dr, Hwy 29 (Beattie Dr), Hwy 29, Hwy 97 and 29.
Park: 55.70321, -121.33224, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 400 m E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 8 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2010 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-21, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BB-deer-walk-0002.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 7-21: about 4,188 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.62 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.4 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
